name: Shakshuka with Chickpeas and Wholewheat Pita

components.name: Chickpea Shakshuka

ingredients.name: Raw eggs without shells, about 8 eggs

steps: Heat olive oil in a broad lidded pan and soften onion and peppers for 7 minutes; stir in garlic and spices.
Add crushed tomatoes, chickpeas and salt, simmer uncovered about 15 minutes until thick enough to make wells.
Make eight spaces in the sauce and crack one egg into each well. Cover and cook until eggs are fully set for meal prep rather than runny.
Scatter vegetarian feta over warm sauce and let melt slightly.
Eggs are best freshly prepared. For later-week storage, freeze only the tomato-chickpea base and add freshly cooked eggs when eating.

components.name: Wholewheat Pita
steps: Divide into four boxes with two eggs each; keep pita breads separately.
